name: Potato Chips
main_spoilage_mode: Oxidative rancidity and moisture uptake causing sogginess
notes: High-fat snack, needs excellent oxygen and moisture barrier
source: FSSAI Manual of Methods: Analysis of Food and Food Products; Labuza & Schmidl, Food Technology, 1985

name: Namkeen / Mixture
notes: Mixed fried snack with spices
source: FSSAI Manual of Methods: Analysis of Food and Food Products; Labuza & Schmidl, Food Technology, 1985

name: Banana Chips
notes: Deep-fried banana slices, high fat content
source: FSSAI Manual of Methods: Analysis of Food and Food Products; Labuza & Schmidl, Food Technology, 1985

name: Popcorn (packaged)
main_spoilage_mode: Moisture uptake causing loss of crispness
notes: Low-moisture snack, moisture is primary concern
source: FSSAI Manual of Methods: Analysis of Food and Food Products; Labuza & Schmidl, Food Technology, 1985

name: Biscuits / Cookies
notes: Dry bakery product with fat content
source: FSSAI Manual of Methods: Analysis of Food and Food Products; Labuza & Schmidl, Food Technology, 1985

name: Fresh Tomatoes
main_spoilage_mode: Microbial growth and over-ripening from respiration
notes: Climacteric fruit, high respiration rate, needs breathability
source: USDA Postharvest Technology of Horticultural Crops; Kader, Postharvest Technology of Horticultural Crops, 2002

name: Fresh Mangoes
notes: Climacteric fruit, very high respiration
source: USDA Postharvest Technology of Horticultural Crops; Kader, Postharvest Technology of Horticultural Crops, 2002

name: Fresh Bananas
notes: Climacteric, sensitive to ethylene
source: USDA Postharvest Technology of Horticultural Crops; Kader, Postharvest Technology of Horticultural Crops, 2002

name: Leafy Greens (Spinach)
notes: Very high respiration, needs modified atmosphere
source: USDA Postharvest Technology of Horticultural Crops; Kader, Postharvest Technology of Horticultural Crops, 2002

name: Potatoes (raw)
notes: Low respiration vs other produce, store cool and dark
source: USDA Postharvest Technology of Horticultural Crops; Kader, Postharvest Technology of Horticultural Crops, 2002

name: Paneer
notes: Fresh cheese, highly perishable, needs cold chain
source: FSSAI Milk and Milk Products Regulations 2011; Dairy Science textbooks

name: Milk (pasteurised)
notes: Highly perishable, light causes off-flavours
source: FSSAI Milk and Milk Products Regulations 2011; Dairy Science textbooks

name: Curd / Yoghurt
notes: Fermented dairy, already acidic
source: FSSAI Milk and Milk Products Regulations 2011; Dairy Science textbooks

name: Ghee
notes: Clarified butter, very low moisture, sensitive to oxygen and light
source: FSSAI Milk and Milk Products Regulations 2011; Dairy Science textbooks

name: Cheese (hard)
notes: Low-moisture cheese, moderate shelf life
source: FSSAI Milk and Milk Products Regulations 2011; Dairy Science textbooks

name: Basmati Rice
main_spoilage_mode: Insect infestation, moisture-induced mould at high RH
notes: Low-moisture grain, keep dry
source: FSSAI Licensing Regulations 2011, Schedule 4; BIS standards for grains IS 10190

name: Wheat Flour (Atta)
notes: Dry commodity, insect control is key
source: FSSAI Licensing Regulations 2011, Schedule 4; BIS standards for grains IS 10190

name: Tur Dal (Toor Dal)
notes: Pulse, moderate moisture sensitivity
source: FSSAI Licensing Regulations 2011, Schedule 4; BIS standards for grains IS 10190

name: Chana Dal
notes: Split chickpea, similar to tur dal
source: FSSAI Licensing Regulations 2011, Schedule 4; BIS standards for grains IS 10190

name: Sugar
notes: Very low aw, mainly moisture protection needed
source: FSSAI Licensing Regulations 2011, Schedule 4; BIS standards for grains IS 10190

name: Salt
notes: Inorganic, near-infinite shelf life if dry
source: FSSAI Licensing Regulations 2011, Schedule 4; BIS standards for grains IS 10190

name: Laddu
notes: Indian sweet, ghee-based, moderate shelf life
source: BIS IS 10190:1982; FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018

name: Barfi
main_spoilage_mode: Moisture gain/loss, microbial at high aw
notes: Milk-based sweet, moderate moisture sensitivity
source: BIS IS 10190:1982; FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018

name: Chocolate
main_spoilage_mode: Fat bloom, sugar bloom from moisture
notes: Low moisture, fat bloom is main issue
source: BIS IS 10190:1982; FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018

name: Toffee / Candy
notes: Hard candy, moisture is enemy
source: BIS IS 10190:1982; FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018

name: Fruit Juice (packaged)
notes: Acidic liquid, needs oxygen and light barrier
source: FSSAI Fruit Products Order 2005; Codex Alimentarius standards

name: Milk-Based Drink (Lassi)
notes: Fermented dairy drink, needs cold chain
source: FSSAI Fruit Products Order 2005; Codex Alimentarius standards

name: Mustard Oil
notes: Pure fat, oxygen and light are primary enemies
source: FSSAI Vegetable Oil Products Regulations 2011; FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018

name: Mango Pickle
main_spoilage_mode: Oxidation of oil, mould on surface
notes: High-oil, acidic condiment, needs oil-resistant packaging
source: FSSAI Vegetable Oil Products Regulations 2011; FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018

name: Chili Pickle
notes: Similar to mango pickle, very acidic
source: FSSAI Vegetable Oil Products Regulations 2011; FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018

name: Chicken (fresh)
notes: Highly perishable, requires cold chain and MAP
source: FSSAI Meat Products Order 2014; FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018

name: Fish (dried)
main_spoilage_mode: Oxidative rancidity, insect infestation, moisture uptake
notes: Intermediate-moisture product, multiple spoilage risks
source: FSSAI Meat Products Order 2014; FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018

name: Eggs
main_spoilage_mode: Microbial penetration, moisture loss, CO2 escape
notes: Porous shell, needs protection from contamination and moisture loss
source: FSSAI Meat Products Order 2014; FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018

name: Almonds
notes: High-fat nut, very sensitive to oxidation
source: FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018; BIS standards for dried fruits

name: Cashews
notes: High-fat nut, similar to almonds
source: FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018; BIS standards for dried fruits

name: Raisins
main_spoilage_mode: Moisture gain leading to mould, clumping
notes: Intermediate moisture fruit, sugar preserves but moisture control needed
source: FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018; BIS standards for dried fruits

name: Edible Oil (Refined)
notes: Pure lipid, oxygen and light barrier critical
source: FSSAI Vegetable Oil Products Regulations 2011; FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018

name: Honey
notes: High sugar, low aw, naturally preserved
source: BIS IS 10190:1982; FSSAI Packaging Regulations 2018

name: Tea (loose leaf)
notes: Aroma-sensitive, needs moisture and oxygen barrier
source: FSSAI Fruit Products Order 2005; Codex Alimentarius standards

name: Coffee (ground)
main_spoilage_mode: Aroma loss, oxidation of oils, staling
notes: Aroma is primary quality, degassing needed
source: FSSAI Fruit Products Order 2005; Codex Alimentarius standards

name: Instant Noodles
notes: Fried noodle cake with seasoning, moderate fat
source: FSSAI Manual of Methods: Analysis of Food and Food Products; Labuza & Schmidl, Food Technology, 1985

name: Muesli / Granola
notes: Mixed cereal with nuts and dried fruit
source: FSSAI Manual of Methods: Analysis of Food and Food Products; Labuza & Schmidl, Food Technology, 1985
